subject: pe
title: Cardio Fitness: Building It
welcome_lead: How do you get cardio fit? With smart, regular training.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: building cardio with running, swimming, cycling, HIIT.
final_note: Find an activity you enjoy and you'll stick at it.

concepts.def: Easy way to train cardio anywhere.

walkthroughs.body_html: Aerobic activity at chat pace builds your engine. Running, cycling, swimming — pick what you love.
HIIT alternates hard bursts with rest. 30 seconds on, 30 seconds off, 8 rounds. Big fitness for short time.
Mixing aerobic and HIIT cuts boredom and trains different systems. Aim for at least 60 minutes of activity a day.
